title: Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: In a lamplit tank of sunken stone tablets and swaying eelgrass, this small cuttlefish ripples looping, half-legible handwriting across its skin, endlessly drafting and revising messages it seems eager to share. Linger at the glass and it will drift closer, tilt its head, and flush a soft gold, which keepers believe is its way of saying hello.
